in_scope: Define 10 v2 runtime interface boundaries as typing-only Python contracts (Protocol / dataclass / Enum / type aliases).
Document the boundaries and their invariants in three public-safe reports.
Provide a focused pytest module that proves the contracts module is importable, side-effect-free, and standard-library-only.
Provide an audit script that re-affirms the contract inventory and the safety/privacy invariants.
out_of_scope: Any runtime wiring into app/main.py, launchers, startup preflight, or config.
Any extraction / OCR routing / classifier / threshold / cue-pack / clinical / DDI behavior change.
Any modification of pre-existing parking / freeze tags.

section_c_contract_boundary_map.ingestion_to_quality: V2IngestionAdapterProtocol output describes a V2DocumentSource that V2DocumentQualityProtocol then profiles into a V2TextVisibilityProfile.
section_c_contract_boundary_map.quality_and_extraction_to_classification: V2TextVisibilityProfile + V2ExtractionResult feed V2ClassifierProtocol to produce a V2ClassificationResult.
section_c_contract_boundary_map.classification_to_review: V2ClassificationResult is review-bound by default; it enters the V2ReviewQueueProtocol as a V2ReviewItem.
section_c_contract_boundary_map.terminology_attaches_to_review_item_opti: V2TerminologyMatchSummary is an aggregate-only optional annotation; it must never expose licensed row content.
section_c_contract_boundary_map.operator_action_targets_review_item: V2OperatorActionProtocol mutates queue state only; auto-accept is forbidden by contract default.
section_c_contract_boundary_map.audit_records_each_step: V2ObservabilitySinkProtocol records aggregate V2AuditEvent instances; no raw text / paths / PHI.
section_c_contract_boundary_map.validation_harness_emits_receipts: V2ValidationHarnessProtocol carries the v1 five-validation set forward unchanged and emits aggregate-only V2ValidationReceipt instances.
section_c_contract_boundary_map.privacy_gate_intercepts_every_emission: V2PrivacyGateProtocol fails closed on any candidate that contains licensed row content, raw text, raw filenames, private paths, PHI, or secrets.

contract_emission_rules: No raw extracted text in any returned dataclass.
No raw filename in any returned dataclass.
No private filesystem path in any returned dataclass.
No PHI in any returned dataclass.
No secret in any returned dataclass.
No licensed terminology row content in any terminology summary.

safety_privacy_statement: MEDAI-V2-RUNTIME-CONTRACTS-01 is a reports-only / typing-only block. It adds a typing-only Python contract module (clinical_knowledge/v2_contracts/runtime_contracts.py) plus a package initializer, a reports-only audit script, a focused pytest module, and three public-safe reports. The contracts module imports only the standard library (dataclasses, datetime, enum, typing) and has no runtime side effects on import. No app/main.py / launcher / startup preflight / config / helper / Streamlit-wiring modification. No license text was reproduced. No licensed terminology rows were read. No private license-acknowledgement file contents were read. No private config contents were read. No terminology_data/, data/terminology/, runtime DB, or source document contents were opened. No private filesystem paths were printed. No raw text, raw OCR text, raw document text, raw filenames, PHI, keys, or secrets appear in any committed file. No external API was called or enabled. No tags created, moved, or deleted. PARK-20..26 tag pairs, the FREEZE tag pair, the term helper/wiring PARK-01 tag pair, and the license-gate PARK-02 tag pair all remain intact. Private adapter implementation and real private-store access remain explicitly BLOCKED. Cue expansion remains explicitly NOT recommended.
